body:
## What this listing is

Radical Storage is a booking service for luggage storage. Its Lisbon page lets you pick a nearby partner, book a drop-off online and leave your bags for the day. The page's title reads "Luggage Storage Lisbon from €1.60/Day | 166 Locations". It says there are 166 locations in Lisbon.

## How it works

The page lays out four steps: find a verified storage point nearby, book online and receive the confirmation, show that confirmation when you drop the bags, then collect them whenever you like. Radical Storage describes its partners as local businesses such as shops, cafés and hotels, so opening hours follow each business.

## What it costs

The listing's headline price is from €1.60. The example location shown was Rossio Metro Station, a shop open 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM, at €3.90 a bag a day, with a rating of 4.8 (821 reviews). Prices differ by location and by how many days you store, so open a specific location before relying on the headline figure.

## Where you can store

The page lists these popular areas in Lisbon: Rossio, Bairro Alto, Alfama, Baixa Chiado, Oriente Train Station, Martim Moniz, Intendente, Santa Apolónia Station, Lisbon City Center, Rua da Conceicao. If your plan is tied to one of them, searching from that area shows the closest points.

## What the company promises

Across all its locations the page shows a rating of 4.8 out of 5 from 669,000 reviews, a €10,000 guarantee, and free cancellation. These are the company's own figures for the whole service, not for one Lisbon location.

## When it helps

It suits walking the hills of Alfama and Bairro Alto without a bag, on arrival day or departure day. If you travel with bags only for a short time, compare the per-bag price with the lockers at the station you are using.
